prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member of the Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP) on its published membership list?
prompts.why_it_matters: BAP membership marks a bank as part of the official industry body, so a claimed banking status that is missing from the list is a contradiction.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the BAP membership page and scan the member list for the bank's corporate name.
prompts.found_when: The company name appears on the BAP membership list.
prompts.not_found_when: The full membership list contains no entry matching the company's corporate or trade name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The membership page fails to load or shows only logos and acronyms that cannot be matched to the name.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) directory of supervised financial institutions under the institution type it claims, such as bank, non-bank, money service business, virtual asset service provider or electronic money issuer?
prompts.why_it_matters: Financial activity in the Philippines requires a BSP licence, and a missing record means the company is operating or claiming status without one.

source.name: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) - Supervised Financial Institutions Directory

prompts.how_to_query: Search the BSP Supervised Financial Institutions Directory by the company's registered name and read the institution type, authority and status fields.
prompts.found_when: The company is listed with an institution type, authority and status matching its claimed financial activity.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean name search of the BSP institution directory returns no institution.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory does not load or the name returns several similar institutions that cannot be told apart.

prompts.question: Does BusinessList.ph carry a listing for the company whose address, telephone number and customer reviews match the contact details the company publishes itself?
prompts.why_it_matters: Third-party directory data either confirms the company's contact details or exposes stale and inconsistent ones.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the BusinessList.ph Philippines business search page, enter the company name and open the matching listing.
prompts.found_when: A listing exists whose address and phone match the company's own published contact details.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no listing for the company name, or only unrelated businesses.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search form returns no results at all or the name is too generic to isolate one listing.

prompts.question: Has BusinessWorld Online published reporting naming the company on earnings, mergers, regulatory disputes or debt events, and does that reporting match what the company says about itself?
prompts.why_it_matters: Independent financial press coverage either corroborates or contradicts a company's own account of its performance and standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Search BusinessWorld Online by the company's name or stock symbol and review the dated articles returned.
prompts.found_when: One or more BusinessWorld articles name the company and describe its financial, deal or regulatory situation.
prompts.not_found_when: A search by corporate name and common trade name returns no article about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search is unavailable or the name produces many unrelated mentions.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the European Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines (ECCP) member directory as a member?
prompts.why_it_matters: ECCP membership is a checkable credential for firms that present European-Philippine business ties.

source.name: European Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines (ECCP)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the ECCP member directory by the company name and open its membership profile.
prompts.found_when: A membership profile exists for the company in the ECCP directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The member directory returns no profile for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search is behind a login or the name is too common to match one profile.

prompts.question: Does the company have a listed-issuer record on the Philippine Stock Exchange EDGE system with disclosed financial reports, shareholdings and material transactions?
prompts.why_it_matters: EDGE records prove whether a company is genuinely publicly listed and how it performs, and their absence contradicts listing or transparency claims.

source.name: Philippine Stock Exchange Electronic Disclosure Generation Technology (PSE EDGE)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the PSE EDGE company information search, enter the company name or ticker and review its disclosure history.
prompts.found_when: A company information page exists with dated disclosures and financial reports for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The EDGE company search returns no listed issuer for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: EDGE is unreachable or the name matches several similarly named issuers.

prompts.question: Does the Supreme Court of the Philippines E-Library contain decisions naming the company in corporate litigation, debt default, regulatory enforcement or director liability cases?
prompts.why_it_matters: Court decisions are the strongest public evidence of a company's litigation record and of liabilities its management may not disclose.

source.name: Supreme Court of the Philippines E-Library

prompts.how_to_query: Use the E-Library full-text decision search with the company's exact corporate name in phrase mode.
prompts.found_when: One or more decisions in the E-Library name the company as a party or in the findings.
prompts.not_found_when: A phrase search on the exact corporate name returns no decision.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The decision search returns an error or the name is too common and produces unrelated hits.

prompts.question: Is the company named on FinTech Alliance.ph as a member or featured digital financial service provider?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership in the fintech coalition is a verifiable credential for firms presenting themselves as licensed digital finance players.
prompts.how_to_query: Search FinTech Alliance.ph with the company name using its site search and open any matching member or news page.
prompts.found_when: A member listing or alliance page names the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no page naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns no results even for a broader term, or page content cannot be read.

prompts.question: Does the IT and Business Process Association of the Philippines (IBPAP) member list include the company as a member or accredited IT-BPM locator?
prompts.why_it_matters: IBPAP membership confirms a firm is a recognised player in Philippine IT-BPM and either supports or contradicts its industry claims.

source.name: IT and Business Process Association of the Philippines (IBPAP)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the IBPAP published member list and scan it for the company's corporate name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the IBPAP member list.
prompts.not_found_when: The full member list contains no entry matching the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member list does not load or is published only as images that cannot be searched.

prompts.question: Does JobStreet Philippines carry a company profile for the company with employee reviews, live job ads and salary data, and is the employee sentiment positive?
prompts.why_it_matters: Employee reviews and hiring activity reveal workplace reputation and test whether the company's stated size and culture hold up.
prompts.how_to_query: Search JobStreet Philippines companies by the company name and open its company profile.
prompts.found_when: A company profile exists with reviews, ratings or active job ads for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The company search returns no employer profile for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The profile exists but carries no reviews, or the site blocks automated access.

prompts.question: Does Kalibrr Philippines host an employer profile for the company with active job campaigns, stated organisation size and benefits?
prompts.why_it_matters: An active Kalibrr profile shows the company recruits at the scale it claims, while absence is a missed hiring channel rather than a legal problem.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Kalibrr's company directory for the company name and open its jobs page.
prompts.found_when: An employer page exists for the company with job posts or company details.
prompts.not_found_when: No employer page matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The employer pages require a login or the name matches several similarly named employers.

prompts.question: Does Lazada Philippines (LazMall) show a storefront for the company as an authorised seller or brand distributor, consistent with the distribution rights it claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: A LazMall storefront is public evidence of authorised retail distribution, and its absence or mismatch undercuts reseller or brand-owner claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Lazada Philippines for the company or brand name and check whether a LazMall store page is returned.
prompts.found_when: A store page names the company or its brand as an official LazMall seller.
prompts.not_found_when: No store page for the company or brand appears in the search results.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Lazada blocks the search or the results show only third-party resellers with no company identity.

prompts.question: Is the company on the Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA) accreditation list of domestic shipping operators, registered vessels or maritime training centres?
prompts.why_it_matters: MARINA accreditation is required to operate vessels or maritime services in the Philippines, so absence undermines shipping-sector claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the MARINA published accreditation list and scan it for the company's registered name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the MARINA accreditation list with an operator, vessel or training-centre entry.
prompts.not_found_when: The accreditation list contains no entry matching the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The published list cannot be opened or the sheet is truncated and unreadable.

prompts.question: Does the Government Procurement Policy Board (GPPB) Online Blacklisting Portal list the company as banned from participating in government procurement?
prompts.why_it_matters: A blacklist entry is a formal government finding of misconduct and bars the company from public contracts.

source.name: Government Procurement Policy Board (GPPB) - Online Blacklisting Portal

prompts.how_to_query: Open the GPPB portal blacklisted-entities list and search it by the company's exact registered name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the blacklisted entities list with a banning agency and period.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the blacklist returns no entity matching the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The portal list cannot be loaded or the name matches unrelated suppliers.

prompts.question: Does Onlinejobs.ph carry a verified employer account for the company with a verification badge and a reachable contact?
prompts.why_it_matters: A verified employer record shows the company really operates as a Philippine outsourcing employer, while stale or missing contacts signal a weak operation.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Onlinejobs.ph employer search, enter the company name and open the employer profile.
prompts.found_when: An employer profile exists for the company with verification status or job posts.
prompts.not_found_when: The employer search returns no profile for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The employer search requires a login or returns too many similar agency names.

prompts.question: Does PhilGEPS open data list the company as an accredited government supplier or contractor with awarded bids, and is it free of debarment records?
prompts.why_it_matters: Accreditation and award history show the company is a recognised public supplier, while blacklist entries show it is barred.

source.name: PhilGEPS (Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System) Open Data

prompts.how_to_query: Open the PhilGEPS merchant information lookup and search by the company's registered supplier name.
prompts.found_when: A merchant record exists showing accreditation status, awarded contracts or a debarment entry.
prompts.not_found_when: The merchant lookup returns no supplier record for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The analytics lookup fails to load or the name matches many similarly named suppliers.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) enterprise directory as a registered ecozone enterprise?
prompts.why_it_matters: PEZA registration is checkable proof of export-zone tax incentives, so a claimed PEZA status is contradicted when the directory omits the company.

source.name: Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) Enterprise Directory

prompts.how_to_query: Open the PEZA enterprise directory spreadsheet and search it for the company's registered name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the PEZA enterprise directory with a locator or enterprise entry.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory contains no row matching the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The spreadsheet cannot be opened or the file is too outdated to reflect current registrations.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member of the Philippine Franchise Association (PFA) on its members page?
prompts.why_it_matters: PFA membership is the industry credential franchisors cite, so absence points to an unaccredited franchise offering.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the PFA members page and scan the member brand and company list for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company or its franchise brand appears on the PFA members list.
prompts.not_found_when: The members list contains no company or brand matching the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The members page does not load fully or shows brand names only, without company names.

prompts.question: Has the Philippine Competition Commission (PCC) issued a merger clearance, commitment decision or antitrust ruling naming the company?
prompts.why_it_matters: PCC records show whether the company's deals were cleared or challenged, and any competition finding is a material legal risk.
prompts.how_to_query: Search PCC commission issuances and decisions by the company name using the keyword filter on the issuance page.
prompts.found_when: A PCC issuance or decision names the company as a party or subject.
prompts.not_found_when: A keyword search on the company name returns no PCC issuance.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The issuance search returns nothing even for broad terms or the filings are unreadable PDFs.

prompts.question: Is the company recorded by the Philippine Exporters Confederation (PHILEXPORT) as a member exporter or named as an accredited exporter on its site?
prompts.why_it_matters: PHILEXPORT listings support export-credentials claims, and their absence questions an exporter's standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the PHILEXPORT site search with the company name and review any member or news page returned.
prompts.found_when: A PHILEXPORT page names the company as a member or accredited exporter.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no page naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search is unavailable or returns only unrelated articles.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Philippine Retailers Association (PRA) directory as a member retailer, mall operator or brand?
prompts.why_it_matters: PRA membership is a public credential for retail operators and its absence contradicts a claimed industry standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the PRA directory page and scan the member entries for the company's registered name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the PRA directory with a member entry.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory contains no entry matching the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory page does not load or lists only brand names without company names.

prompts.question: Does Tech in Asia Philippines report the company's funding rounds, investors or team size in a way that matches the company's own claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: Independent startup reporting either corroborates or contradicts claimed funding and scale for venture-backed firms.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Tech in Asia for the company name and compare any funding or headcount reporting with the company's claims.
prompts.found_when: A Tech in Asia company profile or article names the company with funding or team data.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no article or company profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Search results are behind a paywall or the name is too generic to match.

prompts.question: Does the FDA Verification Portal show a valid License to Operate (LTO) or Certificate of Product Registration (CPR) for the company covering the products it sells?
prompts.why_it_matters: Selling food, cosmetics, drugs or medical devices in the Philippines requires an FDA LTO, so no record means unlicensed trade.

source.name: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Verification Portal

prompts.how_to_query: Use the FDA verification portal search with the company's exact registered name and read the licence and product records returned.
prompts.found_when: The portal returns LTO or CPR records matching the company name and its product lines.
prompts.not_found_when: A search on the exact company name returns no licence or product record.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The verification search does not respond or the name returns too many unrelated records to isolate.

prompts.question: Does Workabroad.ph show the company as a DMW/POEA-approved overseas employment agency with verified principal employers and approved vacancies?
prompts.why_it_matters: Overseas recruitment in the Philippines requires a DMW licence, so an agency absent from the database may be operating illegally.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Workabroad.ph agencies by the company name and open the agency profile.
prompts.found_when: An agency profile exists for the company with licence details or approved job orders.
prompts.not_found_when: The agency search returns no profile matching the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The agency search is unavailable or the name matches several similarly named agencies.
